rule: A complete menu requires standard starter + main + dessert. Named dishes without a supported course remain partial evidence and never fill a primary-course gap by inference.

leadCatalog.role: Official episode/archive descriptions; useful when a dish or menu is explicitly named.
leadCatalog.caution: Do not infer courses or full menus from cuisine/meal-style descriptions.

leadCatalog.role: Editorial episode/week recaps that sometimes name individual dishes or full menus.
leadCatalog.caution: Many recaps mention selected dishes only; preserve them as partial evidence.

leadCatalog.role: First-person contestant accounts can explicitly name served dishes.
leadCatalog.caution: Require clear identification of the show meal and preserve the article URL.

leadCatalog.role: Recover disappeared official/editorial recipe and episode pages.
leadCatalog.caution: Archive snapshots are leads until the contestant and served dish are explicit.
